100-foot-long, 2-headed red dragon with six legs. Created by the gods as arbiters, broke free eons ago.

AC 17, HP 77, ATK 4 rend +8 (2d12) or 1 dual breath, MV double near (climb, fly, swim), S +6, D +5, C +5, I +2, W +3, Ch +3, AL N, LV 16

Coordination. ADV on initiative.

Dual Breath. One head breathes caustic gas, the other lightning. Caustic Gas. Fills a double near-sized cube extending from dragon. CON 15+ or 4d6 damage. Lightning Breath. One head breathes a straight line (5' wide) extending double near from dragon. DEX 15+ or 2d8 damage (DISADV on check if wearing metal armor),

Elder Blood. Only damaged by magical sources. Acid immune.
